name: Durin
description: A dragon created within the storybook world of Simulanka by the Hexenzirkel witch Andersdotter, originally cursed to turn everything it touched into building blocks. After being freed from his fate as an 'Evil Dragon' and granted a synthetic human body through Albedo's alchemy, Durin integrated himself into Mondstadt society.
